freshness_rule: Treat volatile state as stale until Fresh Read against canonical GitHub surfaces.
authority_rule: This manifest and generated packets are pointers only; they do not grant authority.
resume_rule: Resume from the first uncommitted step; never replay a durably receipted one-shot effect.
side_effect_rule: Provider receipt is not downstream-effect proof. Uncertain effects are UNVERIFIED and fail closed.
secret_rule: No credentials, tokens, private keys, cookies, or secrets in continuity artifacts.
provider_rule: ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI providers are replaceable executors; no single provider is canonical.
automation_boundary: Automatic provider switching requires separately authorized runtime/credential infrastructure and is not enabled by this candidate.
